text:
Jordyn M.: hi all, started today! quick Q on benefits/enrollment timeline — where do I sign up for medical/dental/vision and how long do I have?
People Ops Bot: Auto-reply: Welcome! New hires have a 30-day enrollment window starting from start date. Portal: https://benefits.redwood.example/enroll — contact benefits@redwood.example for portal errors.
Ravi S.: welcome @Jordyn :wave: Confirming the bot. If you're eligible for HSA it's tied to the high-deductible plan. FSA (healthcare/dependent) is a separate opt-in.
Jordyn M.: thanks. couple more follow-ups: 1) Can I enroll in HSA+FSA simultaneously? 2) Any steps for payroll/direct deposit so premiums don't get delayed?
Nadia T.: short answers: 1) You can't contribute to HSA if you're enrolled in a non-HDHP medical plan. FSA is allowed regardless but check eligibility rules. 2) Payroll cutoff is `15th` of each month for salary changes/benefit deductions. If you start after cutoff your first paycheck may not reflect deductions until next cycle.
Jordyn M.: got it. I'm also moving from out of state — is relocation reimbursable? I have receipts for movers and temporary lodging.
Ravi S.: We do offer relocation reimbursement for certain offers (varies by role/level). Please submit the relocation request form + receipts to expenses@redwood.example. Required: name, employee ID, start date, list of expenses, scanned receipts. We'll route to Finance for approval. Typical turnaround 3-7 business days once complete.
Ravi S.: Example email body you can paste into expenses:

````
Subject: Relocation reimbursement request - Jordyn M.
Name: Jordyn M.
Employee ID: (from offer letter)
Start date: 2026-03-30
Relocation items: movers ($X), hotel ($Y), mileage ($Z)
Attachments: movers_receipt.pdf, hotel_invoice.pdf
````

Ravi S.: Note: certain categories (like house-hunting trips) require pre-approval. Check policy link in the onboarding doc.
Jordyn M.: thanks — do I need to submit anything tax-related for the relocation amount?
Nadia T.: depends. Some relocation reimbursements are taxable and will appear on your W-2. Finance will mark the reimbursement type during processing and Payroll will include any taxable portion on your paystub. If you want a tax breakdown before approval, ping Finance after you submit.
Jordyn M.: payroll / W-4 stuff — I set up direct deposit but didn't complete W-4 during onboarding. Is that required now?
Payroll Bot: Reminder: W-4 must be completed to set federal withholding. You can update it in the HR portal. If missing, default withholding will apply. Also verify state withholding if you moved states.
Jordyn M.: last one — holidays and floating days? How many do new hires get and is it prorated?
Ravi S.: Full-time employees get 10 company holidays + 2 floating days per year. For year-one it's prorated based on your start date. Contractors/TPs are handled separately.
Jordyn M.: who should I DM if the enrollment link times out?
Ravi S.: DM me or email benefits@redwood.example. If it's urgent post here and tag @Ravi S. and I'll escalate.
Jordyn M.: awesome thanks everyone :pray: really appreciate the quick answers!
Nadia T.: welcome aboard Jordyn :tada: If you want, I can do a quick 10-min runthrough of benefits and payroll timing later today.
Jordyn M.: would love that — thanks :smile:
